tools.name: get_targets
tools.description:
List indexed distribution/release/repository/architecture scopes and counts.

Use the returned values verbatim; targets such as CentOS 8, EPEL 9 or
Fedora 43 are available only if they have been indexed.

tools.name: search
tools.description:
Search manual text/metadata; return ranked hits, snippets and exact identities.

Latest indexed package versions are used unless package_version is supplied.
Omitted scope filters include all indexed distributions and releases.
Supply query for relevance-ranked text search, or manual_name without qu

tools.name: get_manual
tools.description:
Get full manual text by name, e.g. manual_name="ls"; no package needed.

manual_name is the command name (also matches aliases); package is an optional filter.
Tries exact casing first, then a case-insensitive name/alias match.
Search API selects latest indexed packages per scope, preferring Fedora

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.
